data.content:
Reservation
A reservation by someone else affects whether the book can be renewed and requires return by the original due date.<SEP>A reservation by another person affects whether a book can be renewed.<SEP>A Reservation by another person prevents renewal and requires the book to be returned by its original due date.<SEP>A reservation by another person prevents renewal and requires the student to return the book by its original due date.

Library Borrowing Guide
Library Borrowing Guide is the title of the displayed content.<SEP>The Library Borrowing Guide provides instructions for borrowing and returning books.<SEP>The Library Borrowing Guide provides instructions for renewing and returning a book.<SEP>The Library Borrowing Guide provides instructions to check titles separately, return books by their due dates, and request renewals.<SEP>The Library Borrowing Guide explains how to renew a borrowed book, including renewal eligibility, the additional loan period, and the return deadline.<SEP>The Library Borrowing Guide presents student borrowing limits and instructions for checking eligibility, tracking due dates, renewing, and returning books.

Book
A book can be borrowed and must be returned on or before its due date.<SEP>The book can be renewed if nobody else has reserved it or returned by its original due date if it is reserved.<SEP>A book is the library item that can be found in My Loans, returned by its due date, and renewed.<SEP>The book is the borrowed item that a borrower can locate and renew through My Loans.<SEP>A book is the item borrowed and renewed under the guide’s rules.

My Loans
My Loans displays the due date for each borrowed book.<SEP>My Loans displays the book's new due date after renewal.<SEP>My Loans is the place where a borrower can find a book and select the option to renew it.<SEP>My Loans is the interface where a borrower can find a book and view its due date.<SEP>My Loans is used to view the due date for each borrowed book.

Renewal
Renewal is permitted once for an additional seven days when the book has not been reserved by someone else.<SEP>A renewal is a way to get more time with a book, requested before its due date and available once for seven extra days if nobody else has reserved the book.

Original Due Date
The original due date is the deadline for returning a reserved book.<SEP>The Original Due Date is the deadline by which a reserved book must be returned.<SEP>The original due date is the deadline by which a student must return a book if another person has reserved it.

Renewal Steps
The renewal steps include confirming the result and checking the due date again before returning the book.

New Due Date
The new due date is displayed in My Loans after the book is renewed.<SEP>The New Due Date is the updated deadline displayed in My Loans after a successful renewal.

Seven Extra Days
Seven extra days is the additional period allowed for a renewal.<SEP>Seven extra days is the additional borrowing period provided by an eligible renewal.<SEP>Seven extra days is the extension available through one qualifying renewal.

Figure 1
Figure 1 is identified as illustrating the renewal steps.

Due Date
The due date is the deadline by which a borrowed book should be returned.<SEP>The due date is the deadline by which a book should be returned; a renewal should be requested before it.<SEP>A due date applies to each book, and borrowers are instructed to check each title separately.

Confirm the Result
Confirm the result is an instruction to verify the outcome after renewal.

Borrowing and Returning Books
Borrowing and returning books are the processes described in the guide.

Account Eligibility
Account eligibility is a condition to check before borrowing.<SEP>Account eligibility is to be checked before borrowing.

Book Title
A book title is checked separately when several books are borrowed.

Loan Limit
The loan limit is listed in the guide's table.

How to Renew
How to Renew is a section of the Library Borrowing Guide that explains how to request a renewal.

Standard Loan Period
The standard loan period is listed in the guide's table.<SEP>The standard loan period is the normal duration for borrowing a book.

Table
The table lists the loan limit and standard loan period.

data.entity_name: Student book borrowing limits and standard loan period (table)
data.content: The table states that students may borrow a maximum of 3 books at a time and that the standard loan period is 14 days. In the Library Borrowing Guide, these rules frame instructions to check eligibility, track each book’s due date in My Loans, and return books on time. A separate conditional renewal rule allows one 7-day extension when no reservation prevents it.

A three-step flowchart shows how to renew a library book: check the due date before it arrives, find the book in My Loans, then renew and check the new due date. The surrounding guide specifies that eligible renewals add 7 days and are not available when another borrower has reserved the book.

Maximum Books at a Time
The maximum-books-at-a-time rule sets the number of books a student may borrow simultaneously.

Student Borrowing Limits
Student borrowing limits include a maximum number of books that may be borrowed at once and a standard loan period.

Three Books
Three books is the maximum number a student may borrow at a time.

Fourteen Days
Fourteen days is the standard loan period stated in the table.

Twenty-One Days
Twenty-one days is the possible total loan period for an eligible, unreserved book under the standard period and one renewal.

Return Instructions
The guide instructs borrowers to return each book by its own due date.

One Renewal
The renewal instructions permit a book to be renewed once, if the stated conditions are met.

Renewal Rule
The renewal rule permits one renewal for seven extra days if nobody else has reserved the book, provided the request is made before the due date.

Figure 1: Renewal Steps
Figure 1 presents a three-step renewal flow: check the due date, find the book in My Loans, and renew and check the new due date.

Seven Additional Days
Seven Additional Days is the extension granted for one renewal when nobody else has reserved the book.

Renewal Process
The Renewal Process involves checking the due date, finding the book in My Loans, renewing it when eligible, and confirming the new due date.

Renew Button
The Renew button is the control a borrower clicks to request renewal of a book.
